messages.content: The airline moved Sunday’s Atlanta flight and it now lands almost two hours later. Compare the alternatives before their change window closes. I need the real totals with a carry-on and a sensible hotel arrival.

There are three workable choices. Accepting the retimed flight keeps the $602.82 round-trip ticket-and-bag total, but arrival is now 9:34 p.m.; MARTA plus the walk puts you at Hyatt Place around 10:40. The earlier nonstop leaves DFW at 2:20 p.m., lands at 5:27, and can be exchanged at no added fare, so the total stays $602.82. A 5:10 p.m. nonstop on the other airline lands at 8:18; its fare is $579.82, but the carry-on adds $45, bringing it to $624.82.
How do those affect Monday? The roundtable is not until 1:30, but I do not want Sunday night to become a problem.

The earlier flight gets you to the hotel around 6:35 p.m., leaving time for dinner and a normal night before breakfast and the 12:45 p.m. venue arrival. The other-airline option reaches the hotel around 9:20. Accepting the retimed flight means checking in close to 10:40, assuming no further delay. All three preserve Monday’s schedule, but the earlier nonstop gives the strongest buffer and costs $22 less than switching airlines.
And the prepaid hotel will accept check-in at any of those times?

Yes. Hyatt Place has the reservation under confirmation ATL-HP-78426, and none of these arrivals changes the Sunday check-in date. For the retimed option I would add a late-arrival note; the earlier flight needs no hotel adjustment.
Take the 2:20 nonstop at no added fare. Keep Tuesday’s 7:40 return exactly as it is, and update the airport transfer around the new arrival.
I’ll exchange only the outbound segment, retain the existing carry-on coverage and Tuesday return, and shift the MARTA plan to the earlier arrival.

The outbound is reissued for Sunday at 2:20 p.m. from DFW, arriving ATL at 5:27 p.m., with no fare increase. Tuesday’s 7:40 p.m. return remains unchanged. The round-trip flight-and-carry-on total is still $602.82; with the prepaid hotel, the trip total remains $921.02. From ATL, take MARTA to Midtown after baggage claim, with hotel arrival estimated around 6:35 p.m. No late-check-in note is needed, and Monday’s breakfast and 12:45 p.m. venue arrival remain comfortably intact.
